title: Laget Aero One Titanium 3D Printed at Eurobike 2026

takeaways.text: The booth identifies TSB Technology as the 3D-printing titanium maker behind the LAGET brand; the AERO ONE spec sheet listed €19,999.
TSB also showed 3D-printed titanium bars, setback seatposts, racks and anodised finishes, plus the Discovery One gravel frame.

disclosure: Independent trade-show walk-through; no relationship with the brand is stated.
summary: A short Eurobike 2026 booth look at the LAGET AERO ONE from TSB Technology, with the Discovery One gravel frame in the background.
